title: Knotted Flaky British Hazelnuts Victoria Sponge
description: A classic British dessert featuring hazelnuts and tempering chocolate, this egg-free friendly Victoria sponge is a nostalgic treat that is both fatty and flaky.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour and confectioners sugar.
Add the softened butter to the bowl and mix until a crumbly dough forms.
Divide the dough in half and roll out each half into a thin sheet.
Place one sheet of dough on a baking sheet and spread with tempering chocolate.
Top with the second sheet of dough and press the edges to seal.
Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow the sponge to cool before serving.
Drizzle with whole milk and sprinkle with vanilla extract.
